QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: guidedMinimumAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Minimum altitude for guided actions altitude slider.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: guidedMaximumAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum altitude for guided actions altitude slider.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showLogReplayStatusBar
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show/Hide Log Replay status bar

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showAdditionalIndicatorsCompass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show additional heading indicators on Compass

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: lockNoseUpCompass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Lock Compass Nose-Up

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: keepMapCenteredOnVehicle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Keep map centered on vehicle

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showSimpleCameraControl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show controls for camera triggering using MAV_CMD_DO_DIGICAM_CONTROL.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showObstacleDistanceOverlay
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show obstacle distance overlay on map and video.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: maxGoToLocationDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum distance allowed for Go To Location.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: forwardFlightGoToLocationLoiterRad
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Loiter radius for orbiting the Go To Location during forward flight. This only applies if the firmware supports a radius in MAV_CMD_DO_REPOSITION commands.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: goToLocationRequiresConfirmInGuided
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Require slide confirmation for Go To Location when the vehicle is already in Guided mode.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: updateHomePosition
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Send updated GCS' home position to autopilot in case of change of the home position

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: instrumentQmlFile2
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Qml file for instrument panel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Integrated Compass & Attitude,Horizontal Compass & Attitude,Large Vertical

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requestControlAllowTakeover
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: When requesting vehicle control, allow other GCS to override control automatically, or require this GCS to accept the request first.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requestControlTimeout
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Timeout in seconds before a request to a GCS to allow takeover is assumed to be rejected. This is used to display the timeout graphically on requestor and GCS in control.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: vehicleIconSizeScale
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Scale multiplier applied to the vehicle icon shown on the map.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: vehicleIconColor
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Color override for the vehicle icon shown on the map. Empty string uses the standard icon colors.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: liveTrackingEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Stream vehicle position to the live tracking server so customers can follow the flight.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: liveTrackingServerUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Base URL of the live tracking database, e.g. https://your-project-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com/blimp

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: liveTrackingInterval
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Seconds between live tracking position uploads.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: windEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show real-time surface wind (direction, speed, max gust last hour) from the best nearby weather station in the toolbar.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: windStationRadius
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Search radius for weather stations around the vehicle / map centre.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: windRefreshMinutes
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Minutes between wind refreshes.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: windAltitudeFt
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Altitude (ft AGL) for the model wind-aloft estimate.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: windGustWarnKt
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Max gust (kt) at which the wind indicator turns red.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: windSynopticToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Optional Synoptic Data API token for many more stations (CWOP, RAWS, mesonets). Blank = Iowa Mesonet public feed.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: windStateCode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: US state code for the public station feed (AUTO = resolve from position).
